instruction.name: movfr2gr.s
instruction.description: Sign-extend the low 32 bits of fj into rd.

experiments.name: high-unroll memory-assisted chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 5000 --iters 2000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; addi.d $r12, $sp, -1024; st.d $r4, $r12, 0' --asm 'movfr2gr.s $r4, $f0; add.d $r4, $r4, $r5; st.d $r4, $r12, 0; fld.d $f0, $r12, 0'

latencies.notes: FPR->GPR move latency is about 3 cycles; 8.76 cycles of helper latency (add.d plus the st.d/fld.d round trip) are subtracted. Unroll 5000, iters 2000. Raw measurement was 2.98; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.
